summary_1line: Bhishma explains how kings and Brahmanas should act during times of social collapse, stressing pragmatic morality, restraint, and guidance from the conduct of the wise.

image_candidates.scene_text: Two calm, well-trained bulls lower their necks into a wooden yoke and steadily pull a heavy cart along a dusty road.
A hunter kneels in the forest studying drops of blood on the ground as he tracks a wounded deer through the leaves.
